text: Long catch-up with Saskia. Her puppy Biscuit has finally stopped chewing the skirting boards. She's sitting her theory test Thursday at 10am and is properly nervous about the hazard perception bit. Need to text her good luck Wednesday night. Also she's been getting into cross-stitch, doing a huge map of Wales for her dad's 60th in March 2027. Her flatmate Amara is helping with the border.
Dafydd's rejoined the Cardiff Blues supporters club, goes to every home game now. His sister Ciara got a distinction in her grade 6 piano. He wants us all round for her 18th on 2 November 2026.
Coffee with Claire and Seo-yeon. Seo-yeon's cat Miso is on a kidney diet and the vet bills are brutal. Claire's knitting a whole blanket for her nan, two squares a night. Nice morning.
Mehmet passed his driving test first time!! Took it yesterday at half 8. His dad's lending him the old Corsa until he saves up.

Blessing's audition for the Royal Northern is the 14th at 2pm. She's been practising the Rachmaninov for months but says her hands shake whenever she thinks about it. Her mum's driving her up the night before. I should send her something encouraging the morning of.

Amara and Femi are getting a cocker spaniel puppy in March 2027, already picked the name Pickle. Femi's obsessed with Arsenal, has a season ticket in the North Bank. Amara's doing her ACCA exams in December.
Giulia rang. Her grandad passed his eye test after the cataract op so he can drive again. She's off to Bologna for Christmas, flying the 20th first thing in the morning.
Nasser said results day for his GCSE retakes is Thursday 22 October. He's convinced he's failed maths again. Must ring him Thursday afternoon to see how it went.
Marcus mentioned his boss is leaving in January. He's into vintage synths, just bought a Juno-106 off eBay. Wants to start a band with Stefan again.
Need to pick up flea treatment and a new collar before Saturday.

Ciara's cat Pudding went missing Sunday night, still no sign. She's put posters up all round the estate and is barely sleeping. Her boyfriend Oscar is checking the shelters tomorrow morning. Don't forget to message her tonight. Oscar thinks a neighbour might have shut Pudding in a shed by accident, so he's knocking on doors too. Ciara's mum offered to come and stay till the weekend.
Stefan and Laura's pottery class showcase is on Saturday at 4. Stefan does the wheel stuff, Laura mostly glazes. They both want honest feedback, apparently.
Yosef's chess club tournament got cancelled, the hall flooded. He's gutted, he'd been prepping openings for weeks. Plays online most nights now, rating's around 1800.

Cem's daughter has her 11+ on 12 September 2027, way off yet but they've already started tutoring twice a week. Cem himself is training for the Brighton half in April. His wife does all the meal planning, he's vegan now.
Bruno's dog Rolo turns 10 on Friday. He's doing a little party in the park at 3pm with a dog-friendly cake, which is very Bruno. Laura and I are going.

Sofia said she's struggling with her dissertation, supervisor keeps moving the deadline. Hand-in's now 15 May 2027. She's started climbing at the Arch to cope, three times a week. I should check in with her next week.
Oliver got into the county cricket squad! First training's Tuesday at 6. His mum is beyond proud.
Oscar's doing his black belt grading Saturday morning. He said it's the sparring that worries him. Sophie's going to film it.

Sophie and Femi caught up at the quiz. Sophie's reading her way through every Terry Pratchett book in order, she's on Night Watch. Femi's band have a gig at the Brudenell on the 30th at 8pm. Remind me to book tickets.
Nina's rabbit Clover had surgery this morning, a tooth abscess. Vet said she should be okay but has to eat syringe food for a week. Nina's really anxious. Ask her tomorrow how Clover's doing.

Archie's mum is retiring at the end of the month after 30 years at the hospital. Archie's planning a surprise do on the 31st at 7. He's also learning to crochet, of all things, making amigurumi frogs. Need to get his mum a card.

Hemi got his IELTS results: band 8 overall. That was the last thing for his visa. He's flying to Auckland on 5 January 2027 at some ungodly hour. Big family send-off planned at his aunty's. He's selling his drum kit before he goes, Stefan might buy it. His girlfriend Aoife is staying here until she finishes her nursing course in summer 2027, then joining him. They're both pretty nervous about the long distance bit.

Aoife says her sister Grainne is expecting in the spring. Aoife's been sewing a quilt for the baby, all hexagons. She mentioned she'd love a decent rotary cutter, hers is ancient. Good Christmas idea.
Jen's lurcher Bramble has to have a lump removed next Wednesday at 9. She's trying to stay calm about it. Jen's partner Salma is taking the day off to be with her.
Salma's mock exams start Monday. She's doing physics, chemistry and maths A level and wants to do medicine at Edinburgh. Her mum's been testing her on flashcards every evening.

Zhang and Lin had their housewarming Saturday. Lovely flat, massive balcony. Zhang's really into bouldering, Lin plays badminton for a league team. They're adopting two kittens from the Cats Protection next month.

Aaliyah's Grade 8 violin exam is on the 12th at half 9. She said she's not worried at all which I don't believe. Must text her good luck that morning. Her teacher Mrs Okafor reckons she's ready. Aaliyah's also been getting into anime, rewatching all of Studio Ghibli with her little brother. Her mum mentioned she's after a proper shoulder rest for Christmas.
Haircut moved to Thursday 5:30. Bin day is Tuesday now.

Ran into Dafydd at the vets. His cat Mabli has hyperthyroidism, tablets twice a day for life. He's doing his motorbike CBT on Saturday 7 November 2026 at 8am. Says he's more nervous about the cat than the bike.

Spent ages on the phone with Saskia about her brother Theo's driving test. He failed for the third time on Friday afternoon, roundabout again. He's taking a break until March 2027. Saskia thinks he's really down about it. I should give him a ring next week, or at least message.
Seo-yeon is learning Welsh on Duolingo, 300 day streak. Big Swansea City fan too, which I never knew.

Claire's boyfriend Marcus proposed in the Lake District last weekend! Wedding's probably summer 2028. She said she's allergic to anything with nuts, so I'll keep that in mind for the engagement drinks on the 6th at 7.30.

Mehmet's mum had a fall and broke her wrist. He's driving over to Leicester every weekend to help. He and his wife Giulia are holding off on the trip to Izmir. Remind me to check in with him on Friday.
Amara got a distinction on her ACCA paper. Celebratory dinner was Saturday. Her sister Esi's graduating in July 2027 from Leeds.
Blessing's audition went really well apparently, they kept her an extra ten minutes. Results due by 1 December 2026. Must ask her when she hears.

Giulia's dog Nico turned 3 on Sunday, she made him a liver cake. She's training him for agility competitions, first one is in Peterborough on 21 November at 11am. Her husband thinks it's mad. Her daughter Sofia has her first ballet show the same weekend, Sunday at 2pm, so it's a hectic one. I should ask how both went the Monday after.
Nasser failed maths again but by two marks. He's resitting in summer. Honestly he's handling it better than I'd be. Plays FIFA with his cousin Karim most nights.

Marcus and Stefan's band is called Dead Pixels now. First proper gig is at the Fleece on Friday 13 November at 9pm. Marcus is on keys, Stefan drums. They want people there early. Don't forget to tell Oliver and Sophie.
Ciara found Pudding!! She was locked in a neighbour's garage for four days. Vet says she's dehydrated but okay. Ciara is wiped out but so relieved.
Laura's doing her ballet grade 5 exam next Tuesday at 4.15. She's 34 and taking it really seriously, which I love. She said a new leotard would be nice for her birthday in January.
Yosef's son Eli starts nursery after half term. Yosef is a big Spurs fan, always moaning about them. He builds Warhammer armies in the spare room.

Cem says the Brighton half is on 11 April 2027, starts 9am. He's struggling with a knee injury and worried he won't make it. Physio twice a week. I need to message him after his scan on Monday. His wife Seo-yeon is fed up with him limping round the house. Their dog Kofi is apparently the only one who still gets walked. Cem's aiming for a sub-1:45 if the knee holds out.
Bruno's girlfriend Ana passed her PhD viva yesterday afternoon. Minor corrections only. They're having drinks Friday at 6. I should get her a card and flowers.
Sofia's dad has a hip replacement booked for 3 March 2027. She's going home to Porto for two weeks to help. She's also finally entered the regional bouldering comp in February.
Oliver's cricket season starts in April. He collects old Wisdens, has every year since 1985. His girlfriend Nina hates cricket.
Called the garage, MOT is Monday 9am. Then dentist at 2.
Oscar got his black belt! Grading was Saturday, he's been training eight years. Sophie said he cried a bit. Need to send a congrats message, and maybe something for his new belt display.

Sophie's tabby Dougal was diagnosed with diabetes, insulin injections twice a day. She's terrified of doing the injections herself. Her vet appointment for training is tomorrow at 10. Remind me to ask Sophie how it went.
Femi's driving test is Friday at 3pm. He's done 40 hours of lessons. He reckons he'll be fine.

Big catch-up with Nina, Archie and Hemi at the pub. Nina's started a new job at the Natural History Museum, mounting insects, which is the most Nina job ever. Archie's mum's retirement do was a success, she cried during the speeches. Hemi's leaving for Auckland in January and wants a proper farewell, maybe Saturday 19 December at 8 at the Crown. Archie's going to organise it. I said I'd do a playlist. Hemi's into old soul and Motown, so that's easy.
Aoife's a massive Galway hurling fan, never misses a match. Her husband Declan restores old bikes in the shed.
Jen said Bramble's lump was benign!! Op went fine on Wednesday. Bramble is in a cone and furious about it.

Salma's mocks went okay except chemistry. She has her Edinburgh interview on 8 December 2026 at 11am. She's very nervous. Don't forget to text her good luck the day before. Her brother Adam is going with her.
Zhang and Lin picked up the kittens on Sunday, Dumpling and Bao. Lin is already sending forty photos a day. Zhang has his bouldering comp next weekend.
Lin mentioned his grandma's 90th birthday is on 27 February 2027. Whole family is flying in from Shanghai. He's looking for a present she'd actually use, she loves calligraphy.
Aaliyah got a merit in her grade 8! She plays with the county youth orchestra too, concert's on 18 December at half 7. Her mum and dad are taking the whole family.

Talked to Dafydd tonight. The cat's levels are stable now. He passed the CBT on Saturday morning. Wants to do his full licence in spring 2027. Also he's finally watching The Wire and won't shut up about it.
Saskia and her partner Josh are off to Lisbon on 20 November for their anniversary. They're leaving Biscuit with her mum. Saskia's been learning Portuguese for months.
Mehmet said his mum's wrist is healing, cast off on 4 November 2026 at 2pm. He's taking her to the appointment. Giulia's started a sourdough obsession.

Need to buy a birthday card for Claire before Friday. She's into Taylor Swift and jigsaw puzzles, 1000 piece minimum. Maybe a jigsaw? Her party's Saturday from 7, Seo-yeon is hosting because Claire's flat is being redone. Need to bring something for the buffet that's nut free. Also pick up wine and ask Marcus whether he's chipping in for a group present.
